bahrain.title: Contract signed to build fourth bridge between Manama and Muharraq
bahrain.summary: Works Minister Ibrahim Al Hawaj signed the agreement for the fourth Capital-Muharraq bridge with a consortium of Nass Corporation and Nasser Hazzaa Al Subaie Contracting, in the presence of Deputy Prime Minister Shaikh Khalid bin Abdullah. The new link should ease traffic between the two governorates.

bahrain.title: Shura Council may reject longer pension payments for children of deceased members
bahrain.summary: Three bills would raise the age at which children lose a deceased parent's pension from 22 to 24, and from 26 to 28 for students in higher education. The Shura Council may reject them on Sunday over concerns that the extra two years would strain the sustainability of retirement funds.

bahrain.title: Bahrain Bourse adds closing auction and trading-at-last sessions from 1 December
bahrain.summary: From 1 December the bourse will end each day on its regular market with a closing auction that sets the closing price from supply and demand, followed by a trading-at-last session where eligible trades can be executed at that price.

bahrain.title: Proposed genome law sets up to 10 years' jail and BD 1 million fines
bahrain.summary: Five Shura members led by Dr Jameela Al Salman submitted a draft law regulating use of the human genome, with the harshest penalties for human cloning, unauthorised genetic modification and harmful research. Prohibited gene therapy procedures could bring jail and fines of up to BD 500,000.

bahrain.title: Shops get fee exemptions and longer sales in December for National Day
bahrain.summary: The Industry and Commerce Ministry will run a support initiative from 1 to 31 December, waiving fees for promotional campaigns and allowing businesses to extend commercial discount periods, to boost trade during the National Day celebrations.

bahrain.title: Bank ABC reports $165 million nine-month net profit
bahrain.summary: Bahrain-based Bank ABC posted net profit of $165 million for the nine months to 30 September 2026, despite a regional environment hit by geopolitical uncertainty, volatile energy markets and disrupted trade flows and supply chains.

bahrain.title: Bahrain hosts sixth GCC cyber exercise
bahrain.summary: The National Cyber Security Centre brought together cybersecurity specialists from every GCC state to practise detecting, investigating and responding to sophisticated digital threats, as part of efforts to strengthen the Gulf's collective cyber defences.

bahrain.title: Lane closures on Shaikh Salman Highway towards Riffa this weekend
bahrain.summary: One or two southbound lanes towards Riffa will close in phases from midnight on Friday 13 November until 5am on Sunday 15 November for the North Isa Town Junction Development Project. Drivers should allow extra time.

crypto.title: Bitcoin falls to lowest since August as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
crypto.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $72,000 for the first time since 20 August, down 7.4% this month, as Nvidia shares fell up to 13% after Huang's sudden resignation. Liquidations reached $730 million in 24 hours, and traders now watch Friday's US PPI data after a hotter than expected CPI raised rate hike bets.

crypto.title: MSCI confirms Strategy will be dropped from its indexes after 30 November
crypto.summary: MSCI's final review deletes Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi from its global indexes, with Sharplink on a watchlist. Tracking funds may have to sell, and JPMorgan earlier estimated about $2.8 billion of selling in Strategy. Strategy says MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million shares, 3.1% of its stock.

crypto.title: Trump nominates four to fill empty SEC and CFTC seats
crypto.summary: Steven Levine is nominated to replace pro-crypto SEC commissioner Hester Peirce and former CFTC commissioner Kristin Johnson for a second SEC seat. Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland, who both worked on the CLARITY Act, are named for the CFTC. All need Senate approval before Democrats take control in January.

crypto.title: US Justice Department moves to seize $1.2 billion stolen in Binance hack
crypto.summary: According to the headlines, the DOJ is targeting $1.2 billion in crypto stolen in the North Korea linked Binance hack and has disrupted a North Korean deepfake scheme.

crypto.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks $14.2 billion in a month, most since June 2022
crypto.summary: Glassnode data shows stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in the 30 days to 9 November as holders redeemed for dollars, leaving less cash to fuel a rally. USDT trades slightly below its $1 peg and the Coinbase Premium stays negative, pointing to weak US demand.

crypto.title: DTCC to bring tokenized securities to Solana in second half of 2027
crypto.summary: The US clearinghouse will connect its tokenization service to Solana, letting some securities held at DTC be issued as tokens. Analysts say a 2025 SEC rule limiting transfers to registered participant wallets will keep retail and DeFi users out for now.
